manufacturing_process_pillars.title: Hand Scraping
verbatim_points: Scraping is a skill more difficult than woodcarving
It is the precise starting point for machine tools; it removes dependence on other machine tools and eliminates deviation from clamping force and thermal energy
A scraped guideway is not easily worn out because of the excellent lubrication effect
The standard is a flat surface of 50% high points (load-bearing) and 50% low points (oil pockets); slideway scraping is more than 20 PPI (points per square inch), with a 40% contact ratio in use

manufacturing_process_pillars.title: Box Way
verbatim_points: Sliding friction with face-to-face interface; large contact area gives overall machine rigidity, high machining stability, high load capacity and strength
Large contact area gives good shock absorption, damping and dynamic rigidity — long machine life and stable machining quality
Advantage: cast steel and other difficult-to-cut materials, heavy-duty and heavy/rough cutting with high removal rate
Industries: high-hardness steel molds, mold bases, automobile interior parts, small and medium machine parts

manufacturing_process_pillars.title: Linear Way
verbatim_points: Rolling friction with point or line contact; small friction resistance, fast reaction and fast moving speed
Accurate minimum feed unit — stick-slip rarely occurs; lower driving horsepower demand saves energy

Less friction heat allows high-speed movement while maintaining accuracy; bears radial, anti-radial and lateral load simultaneously; preload and slider count adjustable to tune rigidity and load ability
Advantage: reduces machining time on complex work with frequent tool changes and feed changes
Industries: complex workpieces, high-volume small and medium parts, multi-surface workpieces in marine and aviation industries

current_site_audit.platform: Wix (meta-generator: Wix.com Website Builder), copyright 2018, design by megaweb
critical_gaps_found: APPLICATIONS page is empty — it literally says 'updating'. The industry/materials/multi-angle-machining sections have never been filled. This is the single biggest content gap and the highest-value new section.
NEWS is stale — the newest item is 2023 EMO Hannover and the 55th anniversary (2023). Nothing from 2024–2026.
Product pages carry travel ranges only — no full specification tables, no downloads, no CTA beyond a category link. There is no RFQ form anywhere.
The new Greek-god series names appear only as untranslated Traditional-Chinese parentheticals inside English pages (e.g. '(升級版Hephaestus系列H7)') — an international visitor cannot understand them.
Website travel range for KMC-G (X 4500–12500) is out of date; the GN catalogue now goes to 14500.
No distributor/global network page despite claiming sales locations across three continents.
No certifications page, no case studies, no video library (a YouTube channel exists but is not integrated).
